title: ONSure Selective Prediction Risk-Coverage Check v1
description: FR-LEARN-081 Selective Prediction / Risk-Coverage Governance: ABSTAIN/HOLD 비율과 coverage를 함께 관리한다. 어려운 사례를 모두 abstain하여 precision만 높이는 metric gaming을 금지하고 risk-coverage curve를 qualification에 사용한다. A coverage+abstain_rate that does not reconcile to ~1.0, or a coverage below the declared minimum-required threshold (regardless of how high precision_at_coverage looks), is the named negative case.
